transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1216 Norstand Lane?
Yes, this is 1216 Norstand Lane. Five people are here, including my husband who needs oxygen. Water’s inside and we can’t leave. No truck, boat, or seats available.
Thank you for confirming your address and situation. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Five people are here. My husband can’t leave alone—he’s on oxygen.

I heard you have five people here. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Yes, my husband can’t leave alone—he needs oxygen. He’s not in a wheelchair.
I heard you said your husband needs oxygen and can’t leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
Yes, water’s inside. Husband needs oxygen and can’t leave alone.
I hear water’s inside and your husband needs oxygen. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats. We can’t leave—husband needs oxygen.
I hear you’re stuck and your husband needs oxygen. Let me read that back: 5 people; husband needs help leaving because of oxygen; water is inside. Is that right?
Yes. Five people here. Husband needs oxygen and can’t leave alone. Water’s inside. No truck, boat, or seats.

Got it. Five people here. Husband needs oxygen. I've recorded that you need help leaving. No responder has been assigned yet. If water is rising inside, move to the highest floor and call 911 if you can get through. Goodbye.
